# Namespace layout

The cluster's namespace layout by tier, as `kernel/namespaces.yaml` declares it: the one list the installer creates from, the operator selects on and the lints check against.

## 1. `kernel`

| Name | `function` | `holds` |
|---|---|---|
| `kernel-gitops` | gitops | Argo CD, argocd-image-updater |
| `kernel-provisioning` | provisioning | Crossplane, its providers and functions |
| `kernel-secrets` | secrets | OpenBao, External Secrets Operator, Reloader |
| `kernel-seal` | seal | the OpenBao transit seal; a separate RBAC and backup domain from the vault it unseals |
| `kernel-data` | data | the CNPG operator and kernel-postgres (Keycloak, its extensions, OpenFGA, the console) |
| `kernel-authentication` | authentication | Keycloak, its configuration, the event listener |
| `kernel-authorization` | authorization | OpenFGA; reachable from enforcement points only |
| `kernel-control` | control | the operator, the director, the usher, the custodian, the registrar |
| `kernel-edge` | edge | Envoy Gateway, both Gateway objects, cert-manager, external-dns, cloudflared |
| `kernel-admission` | admission | Kyverno and the baseline policies |
| `kernel-observability` | observability | Headlamp (the cluster administrator's view of the cluster, with their own identity); the platform's monitoring and log forwarder when switched on |

## 2. `system`

| Name | `function` | `holds` | `when` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `system-postgresql` | postgresql | the CNPG cluster tenant databases are provisioned on; the kernel's own is kernel-postgres, in kernel-data |  |
| `system-mariadb` | mariadb | MariaDB, for catalog apps that speak no other engine |  |
| `system-cache` | cache | Redis |  |
| `system-s3` | s3 | SeaweedFS, the object store apps take buckets from |  |
| `system-authorization` | authorization | the app instance of OpenFGA, with the components' authorization stores, and the arbiter, the one way into it | requires.services.authorization |
| `system-turn-dmz` | turn-dmz | the TURN edge — STUNner's daemon, its load balancer, its certificate and the record of turn.\<kernel domain>; it relays only to its own pods | requires.services.turn |
| `system-mail` | mail | Postfix (the MTA and the DKIM signer, with the per-tenant keys) and Dovecot (the mailbox store); nothing here has a load balancer | mail.serviceMode=system |
| `system-mail-dmz` | mail-dmz | the mail edge — a proxy on :25, :587 and :993 that holds no mail, no user and no key — its load balancer, and the DNS records that point at it | mail.serviceMode=system |
| `system-llm` | llm | the LiteLLM proxy, its database, and the vLLM instances the claim lists | llm.enabled=true |

## 3. `labelled`

| Name | `tier` | `function` |
|---|---|---|
| `kube-system` | kernel | platform |
| `metallb-system` | kernel | load-balancer |
